test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Directions: Sentences of a paragraph are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the sentences in the correct order to form a meaningful and coherent paragraph.**

A. This usually results from a conviction on the part of the worker that the boss is genuinely interested in his growth and development.

B. More attention should be paid to making this contact constructive and productive.

C. The most vital spot in management is the contact between the workers and the boss.

D. Constructive conditions prevail when mutual confidence and respect exist between the supervisor and the supervised.
solution:
The correct answer is 'CBDA.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence 'C' is independent of any other sentence as it is giving general information about "**the contact between the workers and the boss in management**". Hence, 'C' is the first part.
 
• Sentence B will come after C as it is giving information about making the contact between the workers and the boss constructive and productive.
 
• Sentence D will come after B as it is giving information about inducing constructive conditions.
 
• The sentence 'A' is the concluding part as it says the contact becomes constructive when the worker has faith in the boss.

 

Paragraph after rearranging the sentences__: *The most vital spot in management is the contact between the workers and the boss. More attention should be paid to making this contact constructive and productive. Constructive conditions prevail when mutual confidence and respect exist between the supervisor and the supervised. This usually results from a conviction on the part of the worker that the boss is genuinely interested in his growth and development.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a6c2db12945bba9d674d33112fce66b07f00093d75dae93749f9bdb7bd34e7a.png] **__Hint__**

__
 
• Important Rules to Solve the Para Jumbles__:

 
 
• Read the sentences attentively and try to comprehend the idea or theme of the sentence and eliminate the irrelevant options.
 
• Try to identify the opening (independent sentence) and closing sentences (concluding sentence).
 
• Try to identify the mandatory pairs. Two sentences can be connected through various connectors and other determinants.
